sources.title: How to run Qwen3.5-9B with llama.cpp and Pi | Jeroen Nyckees
sources.snippet: Here's how. Qwen 3.5 Qwen3.5 is Alibaba's latest open-weight language model family. The 9B variant sits in a sweet spot: large enough to be genuinely useful for coding tasks, small enough to run on consumer hardware once quantized. It supports a 256K token context window and performs competitively with much larger models on coding benchmarks.
